THE REQUEST FORM

Craft is a separate field from Level on every line — a "Journeyman" alone doesn't tell a recruiter what to source.

Picking a site auto-fills shift, hours, per diem and reporting location, and pre-checks the certifications that site always requires. That's what makes repeat turnaround work fast to order.

Worth deciding: should customers see bill rates here at all?

CANDIDATE REVIEW

Shown as "Dwayne E." with contact details withheld until approval — an account-level setting, currently off.

Turn it on per customer if you'd rather share full names up front. Off by default protects against direct hires.

FILL BOARD

The orange column is the line customers cross. Everything left of it is yours alone — the customer never sees who you screened or passed on.

Dragging a card into Submitted is what exposes that worker to them, so the board makes that boundary literal.

TWO DIFFERENT CHROMES

Customer portal: light, top nav, roomier.

Ops console: dark left rail, denser rows, more per screen — your team lives here all day and wants volume over whitespace.

Say the word if you'd rather they match.
